mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts the broader economy and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced corporate output and earnings, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a supportive monetary policy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation, low interest rate environment
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 2% and FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which positively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two quarters signals a strengthening economy, which positively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over two quarters.
